detail.longDescription: cwspy.com September 2026 update brings two useful features for Chrome extension developers. The new AI assistant lets you query your extension's analytics history in plain language — answers come as charts or tables. Traffic analytics got a unified view: installs, uninstalls, install-to-uninstall ratios, and markets that visit but don't install — all in one place. https:// cwspy.com/release-notes # ChromeExtensions # WebDev # Chrome
